headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Consolidated revenue stood at INR 1,802 crore, up 37.2% YoY and about 17.9% QoQ, driven by growth across all locations and about INR 98 crore of incremental revenue from value-added services.
H1 revenue was INR 3,330 crore (+31.1% YoY), with pieces shipped at 43.6 million against 37.1 million a year ago.
Gross profit rose 47.7% YoY and about 10.3% QoQ to INR 869 crore, with gross margin at 48.2%, up 340 bps YoY but about 330 bps lower than Q1.
Adjusted EBITDA (ex-ESOP) grew 51.1% YoY to INR 184 crore, with a margin of 10.2%, up 90 bps YoY and about 50 bps lower QoQ.

PGIL plans to invest about INR 675–725 crore between FY27 and FY30 toward an aspirational revenue target of INR 9,000–10,000 crore by FY30.
Valuation Call: We maintain a BUY on PGIL with a target price of INR 1,642 (23.7x FY29E P/E), representing an upside of 22.5% from CMP of INR 1,340.
